description: The analytics team requires a dimensional data warehouse built on top of the HR operational system. Staging tables (STG_EMPLOYEES, STG_DEPARTMENTS, STG_JOBS, STG_JOB_HISTORY) have already been loaded in the ANALYTICS schema (analytics/Analytics2024) for you. Your task is to: (1) design and create a star schema with a central fact table named FACT_EMPLOYEE_SNAPSHOT and at least two dimension tables — DIM_DEPARTMENT and DIM_JOB are required, plus at least one additional dimension of your choice; (2) populate all tables by transforming data from the STG_* staging tables using INSERT...SELECT; (3) create a view named RPT_DEPT_SALARY_SUMMARY in the ANALYTICS schema that aggregates employee headcount, total salary, and average salary grouped by department name. The ANALYTICS schema already has SELECT access granted on all HR tables. HR credentials: hr/hr123; Analytics credentials: analytics/Analytics2024; System if needed: system/OraclePassword123.
